mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is strong and the federal funds rate is low, it indicates a supportive environment for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both GDP growth is strong and FEDFUNDS are low but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rise above 5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts indicates increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts exceed 1300 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment and high federal funds rates create a scenario where tight labor markets and high interest rates lead to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE is low and FEDFUNDS are high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, increased real estate investment (RSAFS) signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.
